title.zh: State hackers drive 420% surge in onchain malware, Chainalysis finds
title.en: State hackers drive 420% surge in onchain malware, Chainalysis finds

current_state.zh: Chainalysis reports a 420% annual increase in onchain malware activity, with North Korea- and Iran-linked hackers using Tron, Aptos, and BNB Chain transactions to host and route malware infrastructure.
current_state.en: Chainalysis reports a 420% annual increase in onchain malware activity, with North Korea- and Iran-linked hackers using Tron, Aptos, and BNB Chain transactions to host and route malware infrastructure.
